signals.summary: ProtoPie announced the retirement of the legacy Individual Plan and migration of users to Pro, offering price locking for one year if acted upon before the deadline.
signals.evidence: On July 24, 2026, the legacy Individual Plan will be retired. Every Individual Plan user is being moved to Pro
